answer_1.quote: In this work, we consider the potential for making extracted snippets more readily-understood in user-facing settings through decontextualization -the task of rewriting snippets to incorporate information from their originating contexts, thereby making them "stand alone".

answer_2.quote: For automated evaluation, we follow Choi et al. ( ) and use SARI ... We additionally report BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a small-scale human evaluation (n = 60 samples) comparing decontextualized snippets with our best end-to-end ( davinci) and QADE-CONTEXT approaches.
answer_4.guideline: Snippets were evaluated on whether they clarified the points that the reader needed help understanding.
